Intermediate.learningGoal: Launch and await concurrent work with coroutineScope, async and launch, tested in virtual time.
gotchas: A failing child cancels the whole coroutineScope
runTest skips delays, so currentTime shows virtual not real time
async results must be awaited or exceptions are lost until awaited
goodSolutionShows: coroutineScope with async/await for parallel decomposition
delay-based logic tested with virtual time
No GlobalScope and no runBlocking in library code
shapeHints: fetching two values concurrently with injected suspend lambdas and asserting total virtual time
a parallel map that preserves input order
a timeout around a slow operation

Advanced.learningGoal: Handle cancellation, timeouts, exceptions and supervision correctly.
gotchas: withTimeout throws while withTimeoutOrNull returns null
supervisorScope isolates child failures but exceptions in launch still propagate to the handler
goodSolutionShows: finally blocks with NonCancellable for cleanup
shapeHints: a retry with backoff using delay and virtual time
a parallel fetch where one failure must not cancel the others
a race returning the first result and cancelling the rest

Expert.learningGoal: Design concurrency primitives with Mutex, channels and dispatcher control.
gotchas: Shared mutable state needs a Mutex or confinement
Channel capacity and close semantics decide dropped or buffered elements
Dispatcher injection is needed for deterministic tests
shapeHints: a rate limiter with an injected clock
a worker pool consuming from a Channel
a single-flight cache deduplicating concurrent loads
